notes: Scope is the BAG pand 0363100012241744 only. West wall is measured from the straight-on Commons photograph (27.35 px/m horizontal, 25.5 px/m vertical, glazing polygons traced in a 220% grid crop). The east wall composition (star glazing near the north end, two window rows and a ground ribbon toward the south) is inferred from two oblique panoramas, so it is labelled inferred. The south end wall has no photograph and carries only a dot cloud. The perforation dots come from a seeded density field: they imitate the character and the clouds under the parapet, not the real positions. The Hebrew text on the north end is rendered as word-like dot groups on three lines at the photographed heights and spans; the letters are not reproduced. The architect is not recorded in the sources used. In-game shot not made (bundles are rebuilt by the integrator).
